title: More Adverbs: 几乎, 甚至, 不得不 / 只好, 再也不, 曾经, 本来, 好不容易, 白, 顺便
description: Nearly, even, having to, never again, once (before), originally, with great difficulty, in vain, and while you're at it.

points.title: 几乎: nearly, almost
points.body: - 他**几乎**每天都去图书馆.

points.title: 甚至: even
points.summary: 甚至 (shènzhì) adds an extreme example, often with 连…都 / 也.
points.body: - 他忙得没时间吃饭，**甚至**没时间睡觉.
examples: {这个|zhège}{问题|wèntí}{太|tài}{简单|jiǎndān}{了|le}，{甚至|shènzhì}{连|lián}{小孩子|xiǎo háizi}{都|dōu}{知道|zhīdào}。
This question is so easy that even a child knows it.

points.title: 不得不 / 只好: have to, have no choice but
points.summary: 不得不 (bùdébù) + verb = be forced to. 只好 (zhǐhǎo) + verb = the only option left.
points.body:
- 车坏了，我**不得不**走路去上班.
- 外面下大雨，我们**只好**在家看电视.
examples: {车|chē}{坏|huài}{了|le}，{我|wǒ}{不得不|bùdébù}{走路|zǒulù}{去|qù}{上班|shàngbān}。
My car broke down, so I had to walk to work.

points.title: 再也不 … 了: never again
points.summary: 再也不 / 再也没 + verb (+ 了) = never again.
points.body: - 那家饭馆太难吃了，我**再也不**去**了**.

points.title: 曾经 + verb + 过: once, at one time
points.summary: 曾经 (céngjīng) = at some point in the past (often with 过).
points.body: - 我**曾经**在北京住**过**两年.

points.title: 本来: originally (but)
points.summary: 本来 (běnlái) = originally, at first (the plan changed); also 'by nature, of course'.
points.body: - 我**本来**打算今天去，可是下雨了.
examples: This question is simple to begin with.

points.title: 好不容易: with great difficulty
points.summary: 好不容易 (hǎo bù róngyì) … 才 = finally managed, after a lot of trouble. (Confusingly, 好容易 means the same!)
points.body: - 我**好不容易**才找到你家.
examples: {我|wǒ}{好不容易|hǎo bù róngyì}{才|cái}{买|mǎi}{到|dào}{票|piào}。
It took me ages to get tickets.

points.title: 白 + verb: in vain
points.body: - 他不在家，我**白**跑了一趟.
examples: I waited an hour for nothing.

points.title: 顺便: while you're at it
points.summary: 顺便 (shùnbiàn) + verb = on the way, at the same time (no extra effort).
points.body: - 你去超市的时候，**顺便**帮我买瓶水.
examples: {我|wǒ}{去|qù}{北京|Běijīng}{开会|kāihuì}，{顺便|shùnbiàn}{看看|kànkan}{老|lǎo}{朋友|péngyou}。
I'm going to Beijing for a meeting and will see some old friends while I'm there.

questions.prompt: {他|tā}（　）{每天|měitiān}{都|dōu}{去|qù}{图书馆|túshūguǎn}，{很|hěn}{少|shǎo}{休息|xiūxi}。
questions.translation: He goes to the library almost every day and rarely takes a break.

questions.prompt: {他|tā}{忙|máng}{得|de}{没|méi}{时间|shíjiān}{吃饭|chīfàn}，（　）{没|méi}{时间|shíjiān}{睡觉|shuìjiào}。
notes: 顺便 = 'while you're at it' — it doesn't add an extreme.
questions.translation: He's so busy he has no time to eat — or even to sleep.

questions.prompt: {这个|zhège}{问题|wèntí}{太|tài}{简单|jiǎndān}{了|le}，（　）{连|lián}{小孩子|xiǎo háizi}{都|dōu}{知道|zhīdào}。
notes: 顺便 = 'while you're at it' — it doesn't add an extreme.
questions.translation: This question is so easy that even a child knows it.
My car broke down, so I had to walk to work.

questions.prompt: {外面|wàimiàn}{下|xià}{大雨|dàyǔ}，{我们|wǒmen}（　）{在|zài}{家|jiā}{看|kàn}{电视|diànshì}。
questions.translation: It's pouring outside, so we have to stay in and watch TV.

questions.prompt: {那|nà}{家|jiā}{饭馆|fànguǎn}{太|tài}{难吃|nánchī}{了|le}，{我|wǒ}{再也|zài yě}（　）{去|qù}{了|le}。
notes: 再也没去 = 'never went again' — but 了 + a decision points to 不.
questions.translation: That restaurant was awful — I'm never going there again.

questions.prompt: {我|wǒ}（　）{在|zài}{北京|Běijīng}{住|zhù}{过|guo}{两|liǎng}{年|nián}，{很|hěn}{喜欢|xǐhuan}{那儿|nàr}。
notes: 正在 doesn't go with 过.
questions.translation: I once lived in Beijing for two years and loved it.

questions.prompt: What does 「{他|tā}{曾经|céngjīng}{是|shì}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{老师|lǎoshī}。」 mean?
notes: 曾经 implies it's no longer the case.

questions.prompt: {我|wǒ}（　）{打算|dǎsuàn}{今天|jīntiān}{去|qù}，{可是|kěshì}{下雨|xià yǔ}{了|le}。
notes: 曾经 = 'once (in the past)' — it clashes with 今天.
questions.translation: I'd originally planned to go today, but it rained.

questions.prompt: {这个|zhège}{问题|wèntí}（　）{就|jiù}{很|hěn}{简单|jiǎndān}，{你|nǐ}{想|xiǎng}{得|de}{太|tài}{复杂|fùzá}{了|le}。
notes: 几乎 = 'almost' — 几乎就很简单 isn't natural.
questions.translation: This question is simple to begin with — you're overthinking it.

notes: 不容易 alone doesn't pair with 才 like this.
很容易 contradicts 路太难找.
questions.translation: Your place was so hard to find — it took me ages.

questions.prompt: What does 「{我|wǒ}{好不容易|hǎo bù róngyì}{才|cái}{买|mǎi}{到|dào}{票|piào}。」 mean?
notes: It's about my experience, not a general fact.
还跑了一趟 = 'also made a trip'.
questions.translation: He wasn't home today — I went for nothing.

questions.prompt: What does 「{我|wǒ}{白|bái}{等|děng}{了|le}{一个|yí ge}{小时|xiǎoshí}。」 mean?
{你|nǐ}{去|qù}{超市|chāoshì}{的|de}{时候|shíhou}，（　）{帮|bāng}{我|wǒ}{买|mǎi}{瓶|píng}{水|shuǐ}。
questions.translation: When you go to the supermarket, could you get me a bottle of water?
I'm going to Beijing for a meeting and will see some old friends while I'm there.
